# Jinko

Jinko provides flight and hotel discovery, trip management, ancillaries, and hosted travel checkout APIs.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/jinko/.

## Actions

- **Add Trip Item**: Add one flight or hotel offer to an existing trip.
- **Create Hosted Checkout**: Quote a complete trip and create a hosted checkout URL for a person to review and pay.
- **Create Trip**: Create a new trip containing one flight or hotel offer.
- **Find Destinations** (read-only): Discover destinations reachable from one or more origins using cached fare data, with optional dates, budget, cabin, and passenger…
- **Get Hotel Details** (read-only): Get descriptive property, policy, facility, image, and room metadata for one hotel.
- **Get Trip** (read-only): Read the canonical current state of a trip, including items, travelers, contact, quote and fulfillment state, totals, and booking…
- **List Trip Ancillaries**: Create or reuse a price quote and list purchasable baggage, seat, meal, and other ancillary offers for a trip without creating checkout.
- **Remove Trip Item**: Remove one flight or hotel item from an existing trip.
- **Replace Trip Travelers and Contact**: Replace an existing trip's complete traveler list and optionally its booking contact.
- **Search Flight Calendar** (read-only): Search cached priced itineraries for known origins and destinations across exact or flexible dates.
- **Search Flights** (read-only): Get live flight offers either by searching a route or by re-pricing one cached discovery offer.
- **Search Hotels** (read-only): Search live hotel availability and priced room rates for dates, occupancy, and one location selector.
- **Select Ancillaries**: Replace the ancillary selections for one trip item using offer IDs from List Trip Ancillaries.
